map.流通合格率计算器求多工序串联时整体一次合格率（各工序良率连乘），适合复杂产线的过: The Rolled Throughput Yield Calculator computes the overall first-pass yield of a multi-process serial line (the product of the per-process yields), which suits the process capability assessment of a complex production line.
map.98%×97%×99% ≈ 94.11%。 工序越多 RTY 越低。: 98%×97%×99% ≈ 94.11%. The more processes you have, the lower the RTY.
map.多工序串联时整体一次合格率。: The overall first-pass yield across multiple serial processes.
map.计算多工序串联过程的『首次合格直通率』，暴露隐藏在『最终合格率 100%』背后的: Computes the first-pass straight-through rate of a multi-process serial line, exposing the intermediate rework hidden behind a final yield of 100%.
map.六西格玛中用 RTY 反推过程西格玛水平与隐性成本，比单看成品合格率更灵敏。: In Six Sigma, RTY is used to back out the process sigma level and the hidden cost, which is more sensitive than looking at the final yield alone.
map.识别哪道工序的 FPY 最低，作为优先改进环节。: Identify which process has the lowest FPY as the priority improvement target.
map.：RTY = FPY₁ × FPY₂ × … × FPYₙ，各 FPY 为各工序: RTY = FPY₁ × FPY₂ × … × FPYₙ, where each FPY is the first-pass yield of that process as a decimal. RTY is always ≤ any single-process FPY, and the decay becomes more obvious as the number of processes grows.
map.：三道工序一次通过率分别为 98%、97%、99%：RTY = 0.98 × 0: Three processes with first-pass yields of 98%, 97% and 99%: RTY = 0.98 × 0.97 × 0.99 = 0.941094 ≈ 94.11% (0.9411 as a decimal). Even when every process is close to 99%, three in series push the straight-through rate below 95%, which means at least about 6% of units were reworked, so the 97% process should be investigated.
map.RTY 和最终合格率差在哪？: What is the difference between RTY and the final yield?
map.最终合格率通常统计『最终合格品/投入品』，返修后合格也算合格；RTY 只算首次就: The final yield usually counts final good units over units introduced, and a part that passes after rework still counts as good; RTY counts only units that passed on the first attempt all the way through, so RTY ≤ the final yield and the difference is the volume lost to rework.
map.工序越多 RTY 越低是必然吗？: Is a falling RTY with more processes inevitable?
map.只要单工序 FPY<100% 就必然衰减，与工序数正相关；提升 RTY 要么提高: As long as a single process has FPY < 100% the total must decay, and it correlates with the number of processes. To raise RTY you either improve the single-process FPY (the root fix) or remove unnecessary processes (slimming down); screening at the end cannot hide upstream defects.
